sanskrit: etaccaturthaṃ kathitaṃ pañcamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu sthiticakrasya deveśa daśamaṃ sarvakāmadam
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: sthiticakraṃ tu jānīyād ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu adhunā śṛṇu sṛṣṭiprathamagaṃ varṇaṃ saṃhārādaṣṭameyutam
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: sṛṣṭisthaṃ viddhi sarvajña saptamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu sthitisthaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ syāt sṛṣṭiṣaṣṭhena saṃyutam
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: saṃhāracakrād deveśa saptamena śiroyutam saptamaṃ tu vijānīyādaṣṭamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: sṛṣṭitrayodaśaṃ yat tu saṃhārāt saptame yutam aṣṭamaṃ taṃ vijānīyāt navamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: sṛṣṭisthaṃ saptamaṃ yad vai saṃhārādaṣṭasaṃyutam navamaṃ taṃ vijāniyād daśamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: sṛṣṭisthaṃ pañcamaṃ yad vai saṃhārāt saptame yutam daśamaṃ taṃ vijānīyād sarvakālakṣayaṃkaram
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: sṛṣṭicakrasyayad varṇaṃ saptamaṃ ghorarūpakam saṃhārādaṣṭame yuktaṃ ekādaśamanuttamam
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: viddhi bhairava tattvena dvādaśaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu sṛṣṭipañcamagaṃ yacca dvādaśaṃ taṃ viduḥ priya 6/37 saṃhārād dvitīyaṃ sṛṣṭeraṣṭamaṃ sthitisaṃyutam etat tayodaśavarṇaṃ viddhi bhairava tattvataḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: sthiticakrasya yad varṇaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca sarvakāmadam etaccaturdaśaṃ varṇaṃ viddhi kālakṣayaṃkaram
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: sthitisthaṃ dvādaśamaṃ yad vai daśapaṃcamakaṃ viduḥ sṛṣṭipañcamakaṃ yat tu saṃhārādaṣṭame yutam
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: ṣodaśaṃtaṃ vijānīyāt sarvakālaṃ mahāmate sṛṣṭipañcamakaṃ yad vai saṃhārāt saptame yutam
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: daśasaptādhikaṃ viddhi varṇakālakṣayaṃkaram eṣā tu paramā kālī daśasaptādhikākṣarā
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: vidyārūpeṇa viddhivat sthitirūpā sadoditā āgatasya tvamāgatya yāhaṭhāt saṃkṣayeratā
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: sthitivat tvacalā nityā daśasaptākṣarā tu sā snānaṃ sānandabhāvena viśonmīlanatatparā 6/44 akṣarākṣaravarṇajñā daśasaptākṣarā tu sā kākacañcupuṭākārā kalmaṣaṃ kalayet tu sā
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: ākalāvarga sahitā daśasaptākṣarā tu sā kaṭkālakamalāntasthā khakalākalanī kulā
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: saṃhāraṃ bhakṣayennityaṃ daśasaptākṣarā tu sā khecarīcakracāreṇa samayāṃ cārayet sadā
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: khakārākṣaramadhyasthā daśasaptākṣarā tu sā eṣā vidyā mahāguhyā sthiticakrasya madhyagā
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: viddhi tvaṃ tvāllakāmā tu daśasaptākṣarā tu sā etad jñātvā tu deveśi pūjako bhava sāṃpratam
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: yena pūjitamātreṇa sthitijño bhavase haraḥ pūjyaṃ tat sarvakālaṃ vai madyairmmāṃsairyathāvidhiḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: puṣpadhūpopahāraiśca lepanaiśca sudīpakaiḥ tatastu devadeveśa samayārthaprapūjaniaḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: pūjyā vidyā suraśreṣṭha sthiticakrasya bhāsakī eṣā vidyā mahākāle sthiticakrasya sarvataḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: kathitā parameśāna pūjanavidhiruttamā śrībhairava ūvāca tvāṃ vidyā devadeveśi sthiticakrasya bhairavi
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: pūjayāmi sadā bhadre samayārthaśivapradām kathayasya prasādena vistareṇa yathā vahiḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: sthitāṃ varṇasvabhāvena akṣarākṣararūpiṇīm śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu māṃ paramāṃ vidyāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: samayāṃ pūrayed rudra bāhyato vīranāyaka gurupaṃktiryathārthato ādau pūjyā suyatnataḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: tataḥ samuccared vidyāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām trayodaśaṃ tu saṃhārād sṛṣṭidaśamasaṃyutam
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: aṣṭamena adhaḥkrāntaṃ caturdaśasamanvitam sthitinavamavarṇena lāṃcchitaṃ piṇḍamuddharet 6/58 sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāyoginivaktragam tatastu devadeveśa mahāśabdaṃ samuddharet
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: āpyāyakāriṇi tataḥ proktaṃ tat tu vicakṣaṇaḥ sthitiśabdastatodhṛtya bodhaśabdaṃ tataḥ param
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: saṃpūrṇamuddhared rudra lakṣaṇe tu padaṃ tataḥ bhavabandhani ca tathā rūpiṇīti padaṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: paramasiddhi ca padaṃ śuddhaśabdamataḥ param bahuśabdaṃ tatoddhṛtya svarūpe ca padaṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: manonmani śive paścāt mahāśabdamataḥ param balaśabdamataḥ paścāt parākramapadaṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: pareti śabdaṃ saṃyojya vyomavāhini cātra vai avatārarūpe kāmānte padamante niyojayet
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: vāgbhavaṃ tu tato yojyaṃ kāmarājaṃ tatoddharet sthitisthaṃ tu tato rudra dvitīyaṃ viśvarūpakam
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: caturdaśena cākrāntaṃ sṛṣṭisthaṃ dvādaśayutam etat piṇḍākṣaraṃ yojyaṃ vyomānte padakaṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: eṣā śatākṣarā vidyā sthiticakrasya pūraṇe samayā sarvathā nātha samadurvāritā satī
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: uttamā sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ gopayet prāṇavallabhe agopyād siddhihāniḥ syād gopānāt tu phalapradā
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: īśvarakathitaṃ rudra sthiticakraṃ vidhānataḥ sarvabhāvesu sāmānyaṃ sarvadoṣaistuvarjiam 6/69 nityoditaṃ niraupamyaṃ yoginīvaktramadhyagam iti śrīmadurapīṭhe vinirgate śrīnāthapādāvatārite śrīkālikākulasadbhāve sthitikramapūjāvatāro nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ || 6/6 śrībhairava uvāca śrutā me sthiticakrasya pūjanavidhiruttamā tvadvaktrāt mahaśāni vistareṇa nirūpitā
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: adhyātma bhāvavibhavo dayanātmarūpālīlāpare taraṇi gurumahārthasiddhau tat saṃhṛtiḥ sthitipadaṃ punarāviśanti muṣṭisvabhāvamapahṛdityakalāntakītām
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: naumi nityaṃ ca bhāvasthāṃ ekāntāṃ dvādaśāntagām ṣoḍaśāntakalārūḍhā vamanti pivati jagat
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: See chapter 15/59 of the Aajñākhaṇḍa śrīmadduttaradigbhāge pīṭhaṃ pīṭhavaraṃ mahat oḍḍiyānābhidhānante siddhiyoginisevitam
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: tasmin pīṭhavare ramye śmaśānaṃkara vīrakam mahācityagnisaṃyuktaṃ mahāmātṛbhirā
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: mahāsiddhaiśca yakṣaiśca kinnarairākṣasaistathā vetālai bhūtasaṃghaiśca piśācai brahmarākṣasaiḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: pretaiśca kinnaraiḥ sarvai bhīṣaṇaistu mahābalaiḥ ḍākinī rākinī caiva lākinī kākinī tathā
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: sākinī hākinībhiśca pūtanābhiḥ samāvṛtam bhairavaistu māhāghoraiḥ sevyamānaṃ samantataḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: vīraistu vīravīraistu mahāvīraistu saṃkulam mahāyoginīkhecaryaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ tu samāsataḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: śivārāvaistu saṃkīrṇaṃ mahārāvaistu nāditam anekayakṣasaṃghaiśca nṛtyamānaṃ samantataḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: anekacaṭtārāvaiḥ sevyamānaṃ mahākulam anekayoginīvṛndai veṣṭālaṃ kālavoṣṭitam
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: tasmiṃ pitṛvane ghore mahābhairavasaṃkule kālpāstu pālyamānā vai te sthitāstviṣṭacetā
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: kecid vallanti nādanti kecid bhāvarasākulaiḥ keci nṛtyanti gāyanti vādyanti cakre pūṭitaḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: cakrācāraratāḥ kecid kecid dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ vīrapānaratāḥ kecid haṭhamelāpake ratāḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: madyapānaratāḥ kecicchavahastāstathāparāḥ * *?stāstathā cānya śirahastāstathāparāḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)

sanskrit: antamālādhalāścānya vaśābhaktyāstathāparāḥ maṃjārudhirapūrṇāṃ tu asthiyuktaṃ tu bhīṣaṇam 7/16 narake tu(?)* *? gṛhya pānago *? paraṃ param ulkābhakṣyāstathā cānyāḥ sūryabhakṣyāstathāparāḥ
source_edition: Dyczkowski ed., Muktabodha (MS 1-76 Saivatantra 144; NGMPP A 209/23)
